# Brief Template

```markdown
# Brief: [Title]
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Author:** [name]
**Audience:** [who this is for]
**Status:** Draft / Final

## Executive Summary
[3-5 sentences: what, why, so what]

## Background
[Context needed to understand the brief]

## Analysis
[Key findings, structured as bullets or table]

## Options
| Option | Pros | Cons | Cost/Effort |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| A | | | |
| B | | | |

## Recommendation
[Which option and why]

## Next Steps
1. [Action item + owner + deadline]
2. [Action item + owner + deadline]
```

## Usage Notes
- Keep under 500 words for routine briefs
- Use for Dialectica project summaries, job search analysis, strategic decisions
- Save to workspace/outputs/drafts/ while in progress
- Move to workspace/outputs/reports/ when finalized
